description: The control of maximal-terminator-nested-query-offset. y≠"ab" does not hold of the longer y, so the omission is permitted, and the text parses (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%elidable maximal T
%rule text W $s(rest)
%conditions begins($s, q)
%rule rest V A B
%rule q V $t(suffix)
%conditions begins($t, r)
%rule suffix A B
%rule r y≠"ab" [T] B
%rule y A | A B
